specification.correction: One-feature standardized ridge alpha=2, minimum 8 earlier eligible MUSA OOF residuals, 0.5 prediction shrinkage
limitations: Historical market inputs are current vintage, not PIT verified
Peer targets from existing annual-table extraction, not all original releases reconciled
Hypothesis informed by the same historical misses
Quarter-end cutoff is a research convention, not an archived forecast timestamp
specification.overlap: Report calendar overlap days as diagnostic, never call this gallon share
specification.peer_feature: peer actual minus expanding-window peer forecast; no copying absolute margins or YoY changes
specification.peer_forecast: Existing seasonal/change model, expanding earlier quarters only, minimum 8 earlier targets; market observations no later than peer period-end
specification.publication_verification: SEC 8-K Item 2.02 cover explicitly references peer period-end and earnings/results; use filingDate conservatively, never reportDate
specification.residual_availability: Earlier MUSA outcomes must have verified SEC earnings filing dates strictly before target cutoff
specification.selection: Latest peer period with positive calendar overlap and verified SEC filing availability strictly before MUSA quarter-end cutoff
specification.target_basis: retail fuel margin before credit-card fees
